bio: Dinea is an acrobat for the prestigious Cirque Liliac – a grand troupe of actors, acrobats, and dancers that tours the greatest cities of the world. Inside the great tent, Dinea is a master acrobat, but outside? She is the Nightwire, a daring burglar as hungry for fame as she is for fortune.
